1  BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PARTHIVJYOTI SAIKIA  ORDER Date : 26.03.2026 Heard Ms. Afrida Sneha Wazbee, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner.
Also heard Mr.Bhaskar Sarma, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the State of Assam.

2. This is an application under Section 482 of the BNSS, 2023 praying for grant of pre-arrest bail to the petitioners in respect of All Women P.S. Case No.06/2025 registered under Sections 109/325/406/495/498A of the Indian Penal Code.

3. It is admitted fact that pursuant to the interim order granted by this Court on 07.04.2025, all the three petitioners had already appeared before the Investigating Officer and have been co- operating with the police investigation.
4. I have considered the submissions made by the learned counsels of both sides.
5. Since the petitioners have been co-operating with the Investigating Officer, they do not deserve to be detained in custody.
For that reason, their pre-arrest bail application is allowed.

6. The interim bail granted to all the three petitioners by this Court on 07.04.2025 is hereby made absolute.
7.
With the aforesaid direction, the Anticipatory Bail Application stands disposed of accordingly.
Send back the CD.
